posts.name: Craig
posts.cooked: I’m taking a break from the usual Saturday night SotM to go see The Avengers tonight. Who else has seen/is seeing it? My predictions for what will happen are as follows. There will be intra-team conflict, a greater evil will bring them down by taking advantage of their differences and non-unified behaviour, they will put their differences aside to (temporarily) defeat the greater evil. Plot predictions brought to you by every superhero team story ever.
